plan_review.notes: Added global workflow serialization to prevent schedule/pull_request_target double-repair overlap; narrowed cloud-agent run eligibility to an explicit predicate over Copilot-authored workflow runs on the exact head branch+SHA and newest-match completion/grace semantics; expanded rollback to cover close->remove and close->remove->readd failure branches with surfaced rollback failures; preserved scan-all/fail-at-end semantics by aggregating repair errors instead of aborting the loop.
